hint.note: 1.50 m/s · H sets aim and spin. Charge to the marked speed; follow the purple patches.

campaign.brief: Roll through the open convenience-store entrance. Collect the purple patches, then park beside the shelves.

hint.note: 5.00 m/s · H sets aim and spin. Charge to the marked speed; follow the purple patches.

campaign.brief: Skip across the ticket hall, then catch the back of a ticket machine for the harder bonus patch.

hint.note: 5.00 m/s · H sets aim and spin. Charge to the marked speed; follow the purple patches.

campaign.brief: Use the seating partition to turn the ball back across the terrace. Bank first, collect on the way home.

hint.note: 1.56 m/s · H sets the suggested aim. Charge to the marker and watch the final rolls into the gold circle.

campaign.brief: Learn the bounce: keep the ball on a straight line and let the last few rolls carry it into the gold circle.

hint.note: 10.00 m/s · H sets aim and spin. Charge to the marked speed; follow the purple patches.

campaign.brief: Ricochet among the East Square garden seats and planters. Every new patch turns the score up another notch.

hint.note: 8.00 m/s · H sets aim and spin. Charge to the marked speed; follow the purple patches.

campaign.brief: Cross the café terrace, bank off its glass edge, and come back over the shallow seating steps.

hint.note: 3.00 m/s · H sets aim and spin. Charge to the marked speed; follow the purple patches.

campaign.brief: Start above the Grand Staircase. Bounce through two flights and collect the trail across Muromachi Square.

hint.note: 2.10 m/s · H sets aim and spin. Charge to the marked speed; follow the purple patches.

campaign.brief: Send a gentle diagonal shot across the open concourse. Pick up the chain before the final landing.

hint.note: 6.00 m/s · H sets aim and spin. Charge to the marked speed; follow the purple patches.

campaign.brief: Thread the locker and recycling area. The return off the shop boundary keeps the chain alive.

hint.note: 8.00 m/s · H sets aim and spin. Charge to the marked speed; follow the purple patches.

campaign.brief: Work the rooftop glass for a long return through the garden. Avoid clipping the planted beds.

hint.note: 7.00 m/s · H sets aim and spin. Charge to the marked speed; follow the purple patches.

campaign.brief: Bank off the drink machines and catch the return. A light touch is enough to start the chain.

hint.note: 5.20 m/s · H sets aim and spin. Charge to the marked speed; follow the purple patches.

campaign.brief: Bounce off the southern frontage and bring the ball back into the hall. Follow the floor patches through the turn.

hint.note: 9.00 m/s · H sets aim and spin. Charge to the marked speed; follow the purple patches.

campaign.brief: Drive a longer line into the lockers, then let the rebound sweep across the floor under the café.

hint.note: 18.00 m/s · H sets aim and spin. Charge to the marked speed; follow the purple patches.

campaign.brief: Launch through the upper garden and out onto East Square. Follow the rebound into the lower arrival area.

hint.note: 5.40 m/s · H sets aim and spin. Charge to the marked speed; follow the purple patches.

campaign.brief: Drop from Muromachi Square to the café level. Keep the ball moving through the steps and onto the terrace.

hint.note: 5.70 m/s · H sets aim and spin. Charge to the marked speed; follow the purple patches.

campaign.brief: Keep a low diagonal line through the space below the terrace. Save enough speed for the far patches.

hint.note: 4.00 m/s · H sets aim and spin. Charge to the marked speed; follow the purple patches.

campaign.brief: Tag the first landing, then ride the Grand Staircase into the lower balconies. The long chain rewards a clean passage through the remaining flights.

hint.note: 8.00 m/s · H sets aim and spin. Charge to the marked speed; follow the purple patches.

campaign.brief: Stretch a single throw across the concourse. Build the full chain as the ball slows toward the destination.

hint.note: 8.00 m/s · H sets aim and spin. Charge to the marked speed; follow the purple patches.

campaign.brief: Leave the west balcony, bounce down the escalator, and carry the chain across the ground-floor hall.

hint.note: 6.00 m/s · H sets aim and spin. Charge to the marked speed; follow the purple patches.

campaign.brief: Launch down the long stair axis. Follow the cascade onto the café balcony and finish the return.

hint.note: 20.00 m/s · H sets aim and spin. Charge to the marked speed; follow the purple patches.

campaign.brief: Send the ball along the enclosed bridge, collect the long rolling chain, then bank off the eastern end.

hint.note: 7.00 m/s · H sets aim and spin. Charge to the marked speed; follow the purple patches.

campaign.brief: Let the upper flights build momentum, then keep the bounce train running across the lower terrace.

hint.note: 10.00 m/s · H sets aim and spin. Charge to the marked speed; follow the purple patches.

campaign.brief: Drop from the high staircase into a distant balcony finish. The early landings only set up the real chain below.

hint.note: 29.65 m/s · H sets aim and spin. Charge to the marked speed; follow the purple patches.

campaign.brief: Throw from the upper deck into the convenience store. Skim the stairs, find the doorway, and deliver between the shelves.

hint.note: 5.00 m/s · H sets aim and spin. Charge to the marked speed; follow the purple patches.

campaign.brief: Tag the upper landing, then relay the ball down the stairs and escalators into the concourse. The distant patches turn a small opening into a huge chain.

hint.note: 14.00 m/s · H sets aim and spin. Charge to the marked speed; follow the purple patches.

campaign.brief: Start near the top of the great stair cascade. Keep a precise diagonal line into the far balcony patches.

hint.note: 22.00 m/s · H sets aim and spin. Charge to the marked speed; follow the purple patches.

campaign.brief: Throw from East Square through the lower escalator banks. Sweep the concourse, rebound, and collect the returning line.

hint.note: 14.00 m/s · H sets aim and spin. Charge to the marked speed; follow the purple patches.

campaign.brief: Launch from the eastern sculpture terrace, cross the central void, and land deep in the opposite concourse.

hint.note: 25.00 m/s · H sets aim and spin. Charge to the marked speed; follow the purple patches.

campaign.brief: Clear the Sky Garden edge and drop through the station to the café terrace. A small change of angle changes the entire landing.

hint.note: 38.00 m/s · H sets aim and spin. Charge to the marked speed; follow the purple patches.

campaign.brief: Launch from the uppermost stair landing, skip the terrace furniture, cross to the eastern frontage, and bank the ball back home.
